name: Web Search
description: Searches the web (via DuckDuckGo, no API key needed) and returns the top results as title + URL + snippet. Lets an agent find sources it can then read with Web Fetch.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web and return the top results (title, url, snippet). Use to discover pages/sources for a topic; pair with web_fetch to read the promising ones.
